the-little-screen-on-your: The little screen on your desk, finally useful.
kiosko-turns-a-small-always: Kiosko turns a small always-on USB LCD panel into a mosaic of live widgets: your AI agents, builds, calendar, weather, news. You lay it out; a tiny daemon keeps it up to date.
free-and-open-source-linux: Free and open source · Linux, macOS, Windows
compose-it-by-dragging-the: Compose it by dragging. The panel follows.
find-a-widget-drop-it: Find a widget, drop it on a to-scale picture of your panel, resize it on the grid, stack several in one tile so they take turns. Every widget has its options and a theme changes the whole look.
the-real-editor-in-your: The real editor, in your browser, on autopilot. The panel shows what it composes, as it does.
every-widget-data-source-and: Every widget, data source and animation is a plugin with the same small contract. {{PLUGIN_COUNT}} come with it (AI agents, GitHub and GitLab, calendar, weather, news, GPUs, local LLMs) and yours fits in a single file.
made-for-screens-that-never: Made for screens that never turn off.
it-repaints-only-when-something: It repaints only when something changes, shifts pixels against burn-in and goes black when nothing needs you. Dark is the normal state: when it lights up, it is worth a look.
one-config-drives-every-screen: One config drives every screen you plug in, each with its own pages that take turns, its work hours and its interludes.
kiosko-drives-1920-462-bar: Kiosko drives 1920×462 bar panels such as the Thermalright Trofeo Vision, square AIO screens and small 320×240 displays, on Linux, macOS and Windows. A magnet on its back holds it to your case; a USB-C cable is the whole installation.
in-testing-other-thermalright: In testing: the other Thermalright LCDs’ resolutions, Trofeo Vision 11.3″ (1920×400) and 6.86″ (1280×480), Fan Bracket Vision-1 (854×480), GPU Bracket LCD 4.58″ (320×960) and Fan Frame Vision-1 (640×172).
drop-a-config-json-on: Drop a config.json on this page (yours, or one an assistant wrote for you) and the panel shows its pages, one panel for each screen, with sample data. It stays in this browser: nothing is uploaded.
the-one-from-the-editor: The one from the editor demo
now-and-then-a-screen: Now and then an interlude takes the screen for a few seconds. The Doom plugin plays the game’s own demos there, on Freedoom’s free levels or your own IWAD.
not-installed-with-kiosko: Optional: not installed with Kiosko, one click on the Plugins page.
doom-trademark: DOOM is a trademark of id Software.
each-one-painted-here-with: Each one painted here with its sample data, by the same code that paints the panel.
on-your-desk-in-a: On your desk in a minute.
nothing-to-install-the-editor: Nothing to install: the editor and a panel in 3D run in this browser with sample data.
node-js-22-18-or: Node.js 22.18 or newer. On Windows there is an installer that needs no Node.js.
or-let-an-ai-set: Or let an AI set it up
everything-is-one-config-json: Everything is one config.json with a published schema. Point your assistant at it, then review what it wrote before it is used.
thermalright-and-trofeo-vision-are: Thermalright and Trofeo Vision are trademarks of their owner; Kiosko is an independent open-source project.
